ryan_cs: FYI customer hit repeated partial-stream responses after token rotation. They see an empty final chunk on reconnect and duplicate last token billing. stack: browser -> our hosted API.
ana_runtime: ugh. do we have a repro? which SDK/browser?
ryan_cs: Chrome 119, JS SDK v1.4.2 in a PW app (service worker). Happens when their auth refresh runs while stream is open. They get a 401 mid-stream, client reopens, receives an empty final SSE frame then resume frames that duplicate last tokens.
lucy_eng: can you paste the sample logs? headers?
ryan_cs: paste logs: ```INFO stream-id=abc123 event=token-refresh start_ts=1672531200 status=401
INFO stream-id=abc123 event=client-reconnect ts=1672531202 token=new-token-id
WARN stream-id=abc123 event=empty-final-chunk seq=2147483646
INFO stream-id=abc123 event=resume seq_start=2147483647
ERROR billing=duplicate tokens charged for seq 2147483646-2147483647```
sam_devex: sounds like a race where client closes connection, server emits a zero-length event to mark final, then resume sends overlapping seq numbers. service worker fetch + revalidate might be retrying automatically.
nana_runtime: interesting note: our runtime currently emits a final "event: done" empty payload when connection closes gracefully. if client reconnects fast and resumes from seq+1, we might still have overlapping in some edge paths.
lucy_eng: could also be a client-side Iterator bug: JS SDK's async iterator marks done on empty chunk then also processes the next resume batch. need repro with a minimal script.
ryan_cs: customer provided a tiny repro (browser): ```const ac = new AbortController(); const s = await client.streaming.create({input}); // simulate token swap setTimeout(()=> refreshTokenAndReopen(), 2000); // service worker intercepts fetch and swaps auth header ``` they said sometimes the final chunk is `"\n"` and iterator.done === true, but the SDK still yields one more chunk on resume.
sam_devex: quick mitigation: SDK can treat zero-length data frames as sentinel but only mark done if server sets `final_frame: true` in JSON meta. runtime change would be to include explicit resume-safe markers.
nana_runtime: we should avoid changing protocol mid-cycle. short-term we can add sequence numbers to streaming frames (we already have seq in logs, but not guaranteed to be exposed to clients). propose: runtime to include `x-seq` header inside SSE comment or a small JSON wrapper `{"seq": 123, "data": "..."}`. then SDK can dedupe on seq.
lucy_eng: alternative client fix: in JS SDK, treat a zero-length event as "possible final" but wait 50ms for immediate resume before closing iterator if a reconnect is in-flight. ugly but lower risk.
nana_runtime: also want to check proxy behavior. customers using Cloudflare Worker + keepalive false can cause TCP close then immediate new connection -> server may still flush an empty comment. please capture edge logs (nginx/edge) and the stream segment store.
ryan_cs: customer is ok doing a quick test. asked them to enable debug on SDK and send us the exact sequence of SSE frames.
lucy_eng: i'll add a small unit test to JS SDK that injects: 1) emit empty final frame, 2) immediately emit resume frames, assert no duplicate yield. target: patch v1.4.3.
sam_devex: assignables: ana_runtime to add seq meta and investigate server-side final_frame semantics; lucy_eng to draft SDK dedupe + short delay fallback; ryan_cs will collect customer SSE raw frames and browser network log.
nana_runtime: timeline? if we can do a canary change to include `seq` in comments (no protocol break) we can ship mid-week. canary will be off by default and used for customer.
nana_runtime: quick note for ops: looking at runtime codepath, empty final frame is emitted from closeStream() -> sendSSE(':final\n\n') earlier. we can switch to `:seq: <n>\n:data: <json>` pattern for all frames.
deploy-bot: [canary-scheduler] scheduled canary rollout for runtime change (seq-metadata) to 3% of hosts at 2026-03-18T02:00:00Z.
ryan_cs: customer verified raw frames and sent a paste: ```event: chunk
data: {"seq":2147483646, "tokens":"..."}

:heartbeat

:final

event: resume
data: {"seq":2147483647, "tokens":"..."}
``` they saw an empty `:final` comment and then resume.
lucy_eng: ok that's actionable. i'll push SDK patch that checks seq and ignores dup seq across iterator sessions. tests + small wait buffer to avoid false-positives.
nana_runtime: i'll make runtime change behind feature flag and add metrics about empty-final vs final-with-payload.
ryan_cs: sending customer patch plan and ETA. thanks team. :thumbsup:
